metadata.title: Density Pass 32 -- Iron Brigade at Herbst Woods (Ticks 16-30)
metadata.description: The Iron Brigade's charge into Herbst Woods to capture Archer's Confederate brigade -- the first major Union infantry action of the battle. The 2nd Wisconsin, 7th Wisconsin, and 19th Indiana driving Archer back across Willoughby Run. Archer captured -- the first Confederate general taken prisoner since Lee assumed command. The moment the Iron Brigade earned its name confirmed.

placements.notes: 2nd Wisconsin -- lead regiment of the Iron Brigade, double-quicking toward McPherson's Ridge
7th Wisconsin following -- the Black Hats are coming
19th Indiana -- the western regiment of the Iron Brigade
24th Michigan -- largest regiment in the brigade. Will lose 362 of 496 today.
Archer's brigade -- in Herbst Woods. They see the Black Hats coming and know they face the Iron Brigade.
2nd Wisconsin charging into Herbst Woods -- driving Archer's men back toward Willoughby Run
7th Wisconsin charging on the 2nd's left -- the woods echoing with musket fire
19th Indiana flanking south of the woods
Archer's brigade retreating toward Willoughby Run -- the Iron Brigade has crushed his right flank
2nd Wisconsin at Willoughby Run -- pushing Archer across the creek
ARCHER CAPTURED -- Pvt. Patrick Maloney of 2nd Wisconsin grabs Archer personally. Archer, furious: Not so fast!
7th Wisconsin holding the Willoughby Run line -- they have driven Archer completely
24th Michigan taking up position -- the Iron Brigade controls Herbst Woods
2nd Wisconsin reforming at McPherson's Ridge -- they have the prisoner. Reynolds is riding up now.
Archer's survivors reforming west of the creek -- Archer is in Union hands. Heth is furious.
19th Indiana in Herbst Woods -- Reynolds arrives, directs the line, is shot from his horse. Tick 28.
